meta.description: Add Discord bot channel integration via Chat SDK.

copy.tagline: 把 Discord 机器人频道接入你的应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要为应用添加 Discord 机器人频道
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Discord bot channels into your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to connect Discord bot channels to your application

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能通过 Discord 收发消息:技能会复制并注册 Discord 适配器、安装固定版本依赖、跑构建与测试,再引导你创建机器人、粘贴令牌并邀请进服务器。
howto.when: 当你提出给 NanoClaw 添加 Discord 机器人频道或集成的要求时触发,例如说“接入 Discord”或“添加 Discord 频道”。

say.text: 为 NanoClaw 接入 Discord 机器人频道。
say.note: 开始执行复制适配器、装依赖和验证流程。

say.text: 添加 Discord 集成,并把机器人邀请到我的服务器。
say.note: 配置后会生成邀请链接,等待你完成邀请。

say.text: 帮我排查 Discord 机器人收不到消息的问题。
say.note: 会按步骤检查意图开关、共享服务器和重启状态。

howto.what_en: Once applied, Claude can send and receive messages over Discord: the skill copies and registers the Discord adapter, installs a pinned dependency, runs the build and registration test, then guides you through creating a bot, pasting the token, and inviting it to a server.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to add a Discord bot channel or integration to NanoClaw, for example by saying “connect Discord” or “add a Discord channel.”

say_en.text: Add a Discord bot channel to NanoClaw.
say_en.note: Runs the copy, registration, dependency, and validation flow.

say_en.text: Add Discord integration and invite the bot to my server.
say_en.note: Generates an invite link after configuration and waits for you to invite.

say_en.text: Help me debug why the Discord bot doesn't see messages.
say_en.note: Walks through the intent switch, shared server, and restart checks.
